scope: Select the GPU provider and card class for Qwen3.8-27B DFlash2 full-logit LoRA distillation using real captures, real hardware, and live account state. This is a provider and throughput decision only.

decision.multi_gpu: not for one sequential batch-1 arm; use process-level data parallel only for a broad post-acceptance matrix
decision.current_stock_boundary: The 20:20Z Prime query listed no Ada. Stock is transient; wait for the preferred card or benchmark a specific replacement. An unmeasured H100, H200, A100 40 GB, or RTX 5090 is not an authorized substitute.
decision.rationale: Prime is the funded full-control on-demand lane with the measured low-cost card. The real A100 80GB control was 1.53x slower and 2.51x costlier per step than Ada; both fit below 10 GiB.
